title: Move to WHATWG
body:
I've started thinking about the steps needed to move this document to the WHATWG and I would appreciate some review (feel free to edit this comment as needed):

- [x] Create `webidl.spec.whatwg.org` and ensure it can be deployed to. @foolip?
- [x] Create a logo. Anyone ideas? https://github.com/whatwg/whatwg.org/pull/377
- [x] Ensure the Twitter account is associated with the Twitter bot.
- [x] Create a PR that updates `index.bs` to follow WHATWG conventions. See #1018.
- [x] Align wpt directory name with shortname: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/30327.
- [x] @heycam to move the repository to the WHATWG GitHub organization.
- [x] @heycam to set up a redirect for `heycam.github.io/webidl/`. Presumably as per https://gist.github.com/domenic/1f286d415559b56d725bee51a62c24a7.
- [x] Update the various repository settings, such as URL, description, branches, etc.
- [x] Update the labels.
- [x] Rename the master branch to main.
- [x] Merge https://github.com/whatwg/sg/pull/167. (This should probably not happen too soon as some tooling uses this database.)
- [x] Merge the PR for `index.bs`.
- [x] Run https://github.com/whatwg/spec-factory and merge the resulting PR. (We wanted to update spec-factory as well for this if I recall correctly. We could decide to not block on that and instead modify the resulting PR as needed to keep some of the existing modifications.) See https://github.com/whatwg/spec-factory/pull/31. The output is already included in the `index.bs` PR.
- [x] Check the box in https://github.com/w3c/whatwg-coord/issues/3.
- [x] Update wpt readme to point to the spec: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/30355.
- [x] Ensure participate.whatwg.org is updated: https://github.com/whatwg/sg/issues/171
- [x] Make changes to specref https://github.com/tobie/specref/pull/686
- [x] Changes to Shepherd?
- [x] Publish a RD draft at the appropriate time (the first one needs some help)

cc @heycam @TimothyGu @domenic @EdgarChen @foolip
